items.title: 1.8.7 Online and Offline Computing Platforms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computing platforms (PDF 30).

blocks.text: Computing platforms aise mahaul dete hain jahan developers apna code likh, chala aur test kar sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Online aur offline platforms
rows: cloud par, internet ke zariye istemal
computer par local development ka mahaul

blocks.prompt: Online aur offline computing platform mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Online platform cloud mein chalta aur internet se istemal hota hai (Repl.it, Gitpod); offline platform aap ke apne computer par install development ka mahaul hai.

items: Platforms: code likhne, chalane aur test karne ke mahaul; online (cloud: Repl.it, Gitpod) ya offline (local IDEs).
